pairs.subject: page-load-pipeline
pairs.evidence: src/stores/i18nStore.ts:60 When a non-Latin locale is applied, script inserts a foreign-origin Google Fonts stylesheet with display=swap and five enumerated weights. No connection to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com is warmed, and the tokens.css fallback chain has no size-adjust or ascent-override, so every late Noto arrival reflows the page. This is dormant in production (LOCALE_RELEASE is empty) but reachable in preview and after any release.

techniques.evidence: src/stores/i18nStore.ts:60 It uses swap with no metric-matched fallback for the Noto families and a foreign-origin font stylesheet with no warmed connections. The weights are enumerated rather than declared as a range.
src/stores/i18nStore.ts:38 The six-family font stylesheet was moved out of the root layout's head, so nothing an English page does not use blocks its first render.
src/i18n/catalog.ts:225 Each non-English core catalog is loaded through a dynamic import. Only the English core ships with every route.
src/components/LocaleOffer.tsx:65 The late, client-only locale offer is a fixed overlay. It is mounted through dynamic with ssr:false and never inserts into the flow above the reader.
